name: Print Restaurant
lede: Print serves seasonal, organic American food in an old print factory, with outdoor spaces exposed to New York’s weather. Tungsten Electric heaters throughout the outdoor and pool areas keep guests out with the view.
data: New York, overlooking the Hudson River
Restaurant in a former print factory – outdoor and pool areas

beats: Print occupies an old print factory and serves sustainable, seasonal and organic modern American food in an elegant setting. Its outdoor spaces look out over the Hudson River.
The outdoor spaces take the full force of New York’s weather. The restaurant wanted guests to use them fully and enjoy the view.
Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric 6000 W heaters were installed throughout the outdoor and pool areas.
